title: Software Engineering Platform Technical Leader
teaser: Take on the role of Software Engineering Platform Technical Leader, where you will design, develop, and integrate embedded software for Cisco wireless products. Lead low-level platform development, drive subsystem integration, and troubleshoot system issues. Ideal for experienced engineers with strong embedded Linux expertise and a background in embedded software development.
description:
Meet the Team  

The Cisco Wireless Platform team builds the foundational embedded software that powers Cisco’s wireless products. We work closely with hardware, system architecture, test, and product teams to bring up new platforms, enable core subsystems, and deliver reliable, high-performance software at scale. Our work spans platform bring-up, low-level software development, system integration, and product readiness for enterprise wireless solutions. 

 

Your Impact  

As a Platform Engineer, you will design, develop, and integrate embedded platform software for Cisco wireless products. You will own portions of low-level platform software, drive subsystem integration, and troubleshoot system issues across development and productization. We’re looking for engineers who combine strong embedded Linux fundamentals with hands-on debugging experience and the ability to work effectively across hardware and software boundaries. The ideal candidate is comfortable taking ownership, driving issues to closure, and using modern AI-enabled engineering practices to improve productivity and execution 

 

Responsibilities

Design, develop, debug, and validate embedded software for wireless platform products. 

Own and enhance low-level platform components, including board support packages, platform services, boot-time initialization, and device-level software. 

Drive hardware bring-up and subsystem integration for new and existing platforms. 

Investigate complex software and system issues in embedded Linux environments and perform root-cause analysis to deliver robust fixes. 

Contribute to performance, stability, and reliability improvements across the platform. 

Work closely with hardware, test, manufacturing, and product engineering teams to deliver production-ready solutions. 

Contribute to code reviews, testing, automation, and continuous integration with a strong focus on software quality and maintainability. 

Use AI-assisted development and debugging tools to improve engineering productivity, code quality, and development eﬀiciency. 

  

Minimum Qualifications 

Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field with 10+ Years of experience in embedded software development 

OR 

Master’s in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field with 7 Years of experience in embedded software development 

Proficient in C and C++, with working knowledge of Python or shell scripting. 

Experience with embedded Linux and low-level platform software development. 

Very good understanding of embedded systems fundamentals, including memory, interrupts, concurrency, and hardware/software interfaces. 

Experience debugging software and system issues in embedded environments. 

Can work independently on well-defined problems and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams. 

Comfortable in taking ownership of features or technical issues and driving them through resolution. 

Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills. 

Experience or strong interest in AI-enabled engineering practices, including the practical use of AI-assisted tools for development, debugging, test automation, and productivity improvement. 

  

Preferred Qualifications 

Experience with board bring-up, device drivers, or BSP development. 

Familiarity with interfaces such as UART, SPI, I2C, GPIO, PCIe, or Ethernet. 

Exposure to networking fundamentals or wireless technologies.

We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
